about: Seed checklist for the GM panel Testing tab (gm-testing.mjs). Built from the 2026-10-02 multiplayer feature report. Each id is permanent: renaming a title here does not touch rows already in the database, and new ids appear on the next server start. Edit live items from the panel instead.

items.title: Heartbeat polling stays live
items.detail: Stand still for a minute; peers, chat and the clock keep updating with no errors.

items.title: Snapshot cache
items.detail: Rejoin a zone; avatars, RPP and dungeon lists load without re-downloading the whole snapshot.

items.title: Retries never double-apply
items.detail: Buy, trade or claim on a laggy connection; nothing is charged or granted twice.

items.title: Tracker gateway routes
items.detail: Zones, cloud saves, characters, sprites and content assets all load through lidoll.dev/tracker.

items.title: Loadout commit
items.detail: Change gear and needs offline-style in game, walk a step; the server copy matches after a relog.

items.title: Accounts and characters
items.detail: Sign in with LiDollID, make up to 5 characters, switch between them.

items.title: One window per character
items.detail: Open a second window on the same character; takeover works and the first window stops cleanly.

items.title: Desktop device-code sign-in
items.detail: Native build signs in with the device code flow.

items.title: Browser / Opera GX sign-in
items.detail: Web build signs in with the cookie session and can play normally.

items.title: Rate limits recover
items.detail: Spam actions until throttled; the client backs off and recovers without a relog.

items.title: Rose Court hub
items.detail: Castle gate, Tundra gate, Market Hall, Dive Hall pads and Castle Dungeon stairs all work.

items.title: Honeydew Village hub
items.detail: Four gates (Tundra, Desert, Haunted Woods, Plains), Community Hall Dive pads, Inn and Farmstead.

items.title: LittleBigCity hub
items.detail: Desert and Coast gates, Coliseum Dive pads, Regression School entrance, storefronts, Prospector's Camp.

items.title: Utopia hub
items.detail: Taiga gate, Hospital and Nursery wall paths, Workshop Dive pads.

items.title: Arcadia hub
items.detail: Plains gate and Castle Dungeon stairs.

items.title: Overworld connections
items.detail: Walk every gate between Plains, Tundra, Coast, Desert, High Desert, Echo Gulch, Caldera, Taiga and Haunted Woods both ways.

items.title: Side rooms
items.detail: Farmstead, Obsidian Spa, Coastal Caverns and Spooky Mansion enter and exit correctly.

items.title: Full dungeons
items.detail: Castle Dungeon, Auto Nursery, Regression School and Regression Hospital load and can be left.

items.title: Instanced Dives
items.detail: Quarters, Dungeon, Forest, Nursery, Mansion, School and Hospital each start, descend and reach their boss.

items.title: Weekly regeneration
items.detail: After the Monday rollover, overworlds and Dives show a new layout and old progress is cleared.

items.title: Old zone ids still work
items.detail: A character saved in an old dive-<name> overworld id lands in the renamed zone.

items.title: Walk and crawl pace
items.detail: Walking and crawling move at the server pace; crawling is slower.

items.title: Forced crawl
items.detail: Stamina 0, knockdown or crawl gear switches to crawling; recovering stands you up.

items.title: Queued walking under lag
items.detail: On a slow connection, holding a direction keeps pace with no rubber-banding.

items.title: Doors, portals and chests
items.detail: Stepping onto a door, portal or chest still triggers it while queued walking.

items.title: Enemy roaming
items.detail: Enemies wander and chase on overworlds; turning the zone's roam switch off freezes them, on thaws them.

items.title: Presence and peers
items.detail: Other players appear and vanish about 30 seconds after they leave or disconnect.

items.title: Room capacity
items.detail: A full room (64) refuses entry with a clear message.

items.title: Dive editions
items.detail: Players on different weekly editions do not see each other; per-character chests stay claimed.

items.title: Party follow
items.detail: Following a party leader keeps you close behind.

items.title: Party invite and join
items.detail: Leader invites, invite expires after 60 s, accept works, cap of 3 is enforced.

items.title: Companion in party
items.detail: A hired companion takes one of the 3 slots; only one companion per party.

items.title: Roster locks in combat
items.detail: Join, leave and kick are refused during a shared battle.

items.title: Party disconnect handling
items.detail: A disconnected member drops after about 150 s; leadership passes on.

items.title: Group travel
items.detail: Taking a door moves party members in the same zone along with you.

items.title: Area chat range
items.detail: Only players on screen when a line is said can read it.

items.title: Chat channels
items.detail: Global, /p party, /g guild and /me all work; other slash commands are refused.

items.title: Chat echo and rate limit
items.detail: A repeated line within 4 s is dropped; more than 5 lines in 10 s is throttled.

items.title: GM announcements
items.detail: Panel and /announce banners show to everyone and end on time.

items.title: Guild founding
items.detail: Charter costs 1,000 coins, names and tags are unique, the guild activates after payment.

items.title: Guild management
items.detail: Invite, apply, approve, promote, demote, kick, transfer, leave and disband all work.

items.title: Guild treasury
items.detail: Donations and upgrades (roster cap, MOTD length, crest) deduct and apply correctly.

items.title: Guild weekly goal
items.detail: Boss clears, quest turn-ins and public accidents add points; 50 points pays each member account once.

items.title: Guild window
items.detail: G opens the guild modal in game.

items.title: Player trading
items.detail: Offer, add items and coins, both confirm; any change clears confirmations; items and coins arrive.

items.title: Trade timeout and refund
items.detail: Leaving or waiting 10 minutes refunds everything; untradeable items are refused.

items.title: Wager duels
items.detail: Stake coins, items and drinks; winners split coins, losers get drinks; a draw refunds.

items.title: RP duels and aftermath
items.detail: Get-ready post required; winners get 15 minutes to dress and feed losers.

items.title: Duel rules
items.detail: No duels inside Dives, no charm, no revive, no Dignity loss for losing.

items.title: Action gauges
items.detail: Higher DEX acts sooner; enemies are staggered; a turn waits for turn_ready.

items.title: Shared party battles
items.detail: Nearby party members are pulled into the same fight and share kill credit.

items.title: Encounter level band
items.detail: Encounters sit within 3 levels of the strongest member.

items.title: Front and back rows
items.detail: Rows only with a partner; back row takes and deals half melee; enemies favour the front.

items.title: Bows and arrows
items.detail: Bows use one arrow per shot with reach; with no arrows they swing as melee.

items.title: Wands and guns
items.detail: Wands have reach; guns are mage-only, cost MP and scale with INT.

items.title: Downed allies
items.detail: A downed member sits out while the rest keep fighting.

items.title: Healing Poultice revive
items.detail: Revive brings a downed ally back at 30% HP and uses the poultice.

items.title: Field magic
items.detail: Heal, cure and buff a nearby party member outside battle; buffs apply in their next fight.

items.title: Touch spell menu
items.detail: Spell cards select on release, hover never casts, works on mobile.

items.title: Hired companions in combat
items.detail: Companion heals, buffs and attacks by priority, and idles when the hirer is away.

items.title: Defeat consequences
items.detail: Losing sends you to your gate at 25% HP with the defeat outfit, Dignity loss and need changes applied once.

items.title: Level-up rewards
items.detail: Each level gives +3 stat points, +15 Dignity and 1 RPP; cap at 100.

items.title: HP, stamina and damage scaling
items.detail: HP and stamina grow per level; DEF softens hits; heals and MP potions scale with max HP and MP.

items.title: RPP shop
items.detail: Buy spells and passives; class and level gates are enforced.

items.title: Read the Room
items.detail: With the passive, inspecting a player shows their Dignity label and Shame.

items.title: Mage spell picks
items.detail: Online mages get a free spell every 3rd level.

items.title: Gods and vows
items.detail: First vow is free; switching costs 1 diamond or 5 stars and resets piety.

items.title: Piety and blessings
items.detail: Wearing the uniform raises piety, breaking it lowers it; blessings scale with piety.

items.title: Crafting skills
items.detail: Alchemy, smithing, tailoring and cooking gain XP and level up.

items.title: Alchemy brewing
items.detail: Brew at a hub cauldron and with the portable kit; rarity and potency roll; mishaps happen.

items.title: Choosable start
items.detail: New characters pick a start hub and patron; older characters get a one-time picker.

items.title: Wallet currencies
items.detail: Coins, diamonds and stars show correctly and match the tracker.

items.title: Daily coin cap
items.detail: Earnings stop at the daily cap and resume the next UTC day.

items.title: Loot rolls
items.detail: Chests and drops roll adjective, item and rarity; legendaries are never cursed.

items.title: Hub shops
items.detail: Shelves have 16 items, re-roll daily and stay within each hub's level band.

items.title: LittleBigCity storefronts
items.detail: Each merchant has a storefront; doors move at the monthly rollover.

items.title: Resale rights
items.detail: Server loot and purchases sell for half; rights follow items through trades.

items.title: Bank
items.detail: Deposit, withdraw and sell from the bank; 512-item limit.

items.title: Player stores
items.detail: Open a store for 1,000 coins, list verified goods, buy and sell, buy orders fill.

items.title: Coin sinks
items.detail: Cursebreaker, pay toilets and companion shop rolls charge the right amount.

items.title: Diamond spends
items.detail: Premium companion rolls (rare or better), private sprites, follower hires and god tributes each cost 1 diamond.

items.title: Real-money store
items.detail: Sandbox purchase of a diamond pack and a gifted coin pack; supporter star appears; refund claws back.

items.title: Needs sync
items.detail: Bladder, bowel, hunger and thirst carry over correctly between zones and relogs.

items.title: Witnessed accidents
items.detail: An accident with another player on screen costs Dignity; alone it does not (outside the Plains).

items.title: Accident zone modifiers
items.detail: Open field, tall grass, rain, Caldera heat, Gulch flood, Arcadia and Utopia change the cost.

items.title: Unnoticed accidents
items.detail: Below 30% continence, some accidents are silent and cost extra Dignity when discovered.

items.title: Dignity and Shame meters
items.detail: HUD shows CONTINENCE, DIGNITY, SHAME then the diaper row; Shame changes with the predicament.

items.title: Smell
items.detail: A worn mess borrows Dignity and shows stink wisps to others; cleaning up returns it.

items.title: Activity chat lines
items.detail: Accidents, changes, fidgets and excitement peaks post an area line on-screen players see.

items.title: Player inspection
items.detail: Inspecting shows paperdoll, gear, diaper state, smell and face tier, never raw data.

items.title: Hub toilets
items.detail: Outhouses, porcelain, potty chairs and cabanas relieve you; a cursed diaper blocks them.

items.title: Arcadia pay toilets
items.detail: Charges 5 coins once, then relieves you.

items.title: Utopia changing stations
items.detail: Free stations change you; unpadded players get a smart diaper.

items.title: Companion eat and drink
items.detail: Eating or drinking from the companion applet updates the character like in game.

items.title: Plains rain
items.detail: Showers appear for everyone at the same time and halve accident Dignity loss.

items.title: Plains cover and wells
items.detail: Tall grass and shelter hide accidents; wells refill thirst and add pressure.

items.title: Pink Mist
items.detail: Mist rooms appear in Dives; an excitement peak inside doubles the Dignity loss.

items.title: Drifting Pink Smoke
items.detail: Clouds drift on overworlds; crawling inside raises wet, tum and excitement.

items.title: Seafoam Coast tides
items.detail: High tide floods the sand on schedule; wading adds wet; cabanas shelter.

items.title: Emberfall Caldera
items.detail: Heat drains thirst, eruptions startle near vents, hot springs restore stamina.

items.title: Echo Gulch
items.detail: Floods soak clothes, echo widens monster hearing, whisper stones gossip about you.

items.title: Dark floors
items.detail: Mansion and dungeon floors are dark around the player.

items.title: Fog of war
items.detail: Overworlds start remembered with haze; no fog on the Plains or Coast.

items.title: Arcadia Big Rules
items.detail: Little tax, merchants refuse wet or messy players, smog, shift whistle, no changers.

items.title: Utopia Padded Pride
items.detail: No accident Dignity loss, padding lowers Shame, adult clothes raise it, Nap Pods restore Dignity.

items.title: Online quests
items.detail: Accept, progress each objective type, branch and turn in; up to 16 active.

items.title: Quest rewards
items.detail: Coins, XP, RPP, items and flags arrive once; coins respect the daily cap.

items.title: Repeatable quests
items.detail: Daily, weekly and cooldown quests come back on time.

items.title: Party-shared objectives
items.detail: Sharing objectives credit party members within 8 tiles.

items.title: Minimap quest guide
items.detail: Gold marker on the exit to take, blue marker on the target; quest_track switches quests.

items.title: Story flows
items.detail: A published flow plays dialogue, choices, conditions, rewards and battles correctly.

items.title: NPC stories on bump
items.detail: Walking into an NPC with a bound story auto-plays it.

items.title: Story orbs
items.detail: Orbs read once, stay dormant until their prerequisite is read, and reveal or hide by flag.

items.title: AI companion chat
items.detail: Naming a hired companion in chat gets a reply; with the AI hosts down, the fallback line appears.

items.title: Pip the tutor
items.detail: Pip answers questions in every lobby and enforces the daily limit.

items.title: Companion web applet
items.detail: Gear, eat and drink, shop rolls, bank, guild management and guild chat all work.

items.title: GM sign-in
items.detail: Only accounts with the gamemaster role get in; others are refused.

items.title: Live tuning
items.detail: Changing a Loot tab value reaches the next chest or request with no restart.

items.title: In-game GM tools
items.detail: Warp, summon, zone reload, chat delete and clear, combat tuning, faith set and god mode.

items.title: Moderation
items.detail: Mute and suspend take effect and expire; every GM action appears in the audit log.

items.title: Test-account resets
items.detail: Players tab resets flags, quests, stories and orbs for a test character.

items.title: RP Journal levels
items.detail: Reviewing a journal and awarding a level grants XP correctly.

items.title: Zones tab editing
items.detail: Place and remove monsters, NPCs, tokens and orbs; regenerate a Dive.

items.title: Flow editor
items.detail: Create, test and publish a story flow from /gm/flow-editor.

items.title: Performance tab
items.detail: CPU, loop delay, memory and timings update every minute.

items.title: Art generation jobs
items.detail: Start, approve and assign a PixelLab sprite job.
